home.researchText: Kambe i-dementia ingavikelwa na? Imidlalo yengqondo iyanceda na? Kuthiwani ngokuzila ukudla, ukudla okunempilo, ubuthongo lokuzwa? Izimpendulo ezicacileyo ezilezibonakaliso, kufaka lalapho ubufakazi bungaqinanga khona.
home.appText: I-app yamahala isebenza langaphandle kwe-inthanethi njalo ingasebenzisa izithombe zemuli ozikhethayo, ezilondolozwe kudivayisi yakho kuphela. Umklamo ofanayo othulileyo: izikwele ezine ezinkulu, asikho isikhathi esikhalayo, akula manqaku.

faq.q: Welche Spiele eignen sich gut für ältere Menschen?
faq.a: Gute Spiele sind einfach, vertraut und ohne Druck: große Bilder zum Zuordnen, Sortieren, leichte Puzzles, das Ergänzen bekannter Sprichwörter, Ausmalen, Bilderbingo und Gesprächskarten. Sie passen zu vielen älteren Menschen, auch zu Menschen mit Demenz. Die beste Wahl ist das Spiel, das die Person heute gern mag. Vermeiden Sie Zeitmessung, Punkte und alles, was sich wie ein Test anfühlt.

Yebo. Yonke imidlalo nezinto ezingaphrintwa kuCreative Activities ayimahhala, ayidingi i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Imidlalo isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu ku-foni, kuthebulethi noma kukhompyutha.

faq.q: Ingabe imidlalo yengqondo ivimbela isifo sokukhohlwa?
faq.a: Es wurde bisher kein Spiel nachgewiesen, das Demenz verhindert, und Creative Activities behauptet nicht, etwas zu behandeln oder zu verhindern. Unsere Spiele dienen dem Vergnügen und der gemeinsam verbrachten Zeit, und keine Aktivitätsseite enthält gesundheitsbezogene Behauptungen.

faq.q: Ingabe lezi zimidlalo zifanele umuntu one-Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Yebo. I-Alzheimer's yisona sizathu esivame kakhulu sesifo sokukhohlwa, futhi imidlalo yenzelwe lona: izithombe ezinkulu ezihlala zibonakala, izinketho ezimbalwa, nokungabi nalutho okufanele ukukhumbula noma ukungakwenza kahle. Ukufanisa, ukuhlela nokuqedela izaga ezaziwayo kusekelwe olwazini umuntu alubambe isikhathi eside, hhayi ekufundeni okusha.

faq.q: Ingabe umuntu onesifo sokukhohlwa esesigabeni esiphezulu angazisebenzisa lezi zimsebenzi?
faq.a: Kaningi yebo, uma kukhona omunye umuntu eduze kwakhe. Qala ngoMdlalo Wokuthola Okufanayo Ngezithombe Ezimbili, Izithombe Ezimbili Ngamathayela Amane, ikhasi lokudweba noma ukuphefumula ngokuthula. Yenza kube mfushane, landela ukuthanda kwakhe, bese uyeka uma sewanele.

Lesi sayithi asinawo ama-akhawunti futhi asinazo izikhangiso. Sisebenzisa i-Google Analytics ukuqonda ukuthi yimaphi amakhasi avakashelwa. Izithombe ozikhethela Izithombe Ezimbili zibonakala kusiphequluli sakho kuphela futhi azilayelwa.

Creative Activities ist ein kleines Team, das ruhige, kreative Aktivitäten für Erwachsene entwickelt, für alle, die jemanden begleiten, im Web und als kostenlose App. Wir sind keine Ärztinnen und Ärzte, und nichts hier ist medizinischer Rat.

about.bodyHtml:
Ngubani le yenzelwe

Noma ngubani onakekela umuntu: umzali, ogogo noma ukhokho, umntwana, umlingani, umngane, noma umuntu ophila nedementia. Imindeni, abantu abadala kanye nabasebenzi bemisebenzi bonke bangasebenzisa amakhasi afanayo.

Esikukholelwayo

Inhloso yomsebenzi yisikhathi ngokwaso: ingxoxo, ukumomotheka, injabulo yokuhlanganisa izithombe ezimbili, noma ukuhlala nje eduze. Akusiwo ukulinganisa noma ubani, ukumphelelisa ngaphezu kwalokho, noma ukufakazela okuthile.

Izinhlelo eziningi zokuqeqesha ingqondo zakhelwe ngesivinini, amaphuzu, ukuqhubeka okulandelanayo namazinga. Kumuntu okhathele, ongaphili kahle noma ophila nedementia, lokho kungazwakala njengohlolo angeke alidlule. Sakha okuphambene nalokho, futhi sizibophezele ezimisweni elandelayo:

  • Akukho okungahlulwa. Akukho iwashi, iphuzu, isibali-zinyathelo, izimpilo, ukuqhubeka okulandelanayo, izinhlamvu zokuhlobisa noma ukubala okuhla ngesikhathi, kunoma yiluphi uhlelo.
  • Ukubona kubaluleke kunokukhumbula. Izithombe zihlala zibonakala njalo. Izikhuthazi zimemezela ingxoxo futhi azikaze zibuze ngamagama noma ngenkumbulo.
  • Kukhulu, kulula futhi kuzinzile. Imibhalo nezithombe ezinkulu, umehluko omkhulu wemibala, nezilawuli ezihlala endaweni efanayo.
  • Ukuhlonishwa kwabantu abadala. Izithombe zempilo yangempela namagama alula afudumele. Akukho izithombe zamahlaya, ukudumisa okuculwayo noma imiklomelo yama-emoji.
  • Indlela elula yokuphuma. “Kuphelile okwamanje” njalo kuyabonakala. Ukuyeka phakathi kuwumphumela omuhle.
  • Iyimfihlo ngokwemvelo. Akukho ama-akhawunti noma izikhangiso. Izithombe ozikhethayo zihlala kudivayisi yakho.

Esingeke sikusho

Imidlalo nemisebenzi yethu yenzelwe injabulo nokuxhumana. Ayihlolisisi, ayihloli, ayilinganisi, ayelaphi, ayinciphisi noma ayivimbi i-dementia noma isifo se-Alzheimer’s, futhi akekho kumuntu okufanele ayikhethe ngalesosizathu. Lapho sibhala ngocwaningo lwezempilo, sitshela ngokusobala ukuthi ubufakazi buncane kanjani, futhi asikaze sililinganise nemisebenzi yethu.

Ngubani thina

I-Creative Activities yiqembu elincane elizimele. Asiyona odokotela. Izincwadi zethu zibhalwe ngokusekelwe kwezeluleko ezishicilelwe yizinhlangano ezifana ne-National Institute on Aging ne-Alzheimer’s Association, futhi zonke izincwadi zibala imithombo yazo. Funda ukuthi sibhala kanjani futhi siyihlola kanjani amakhasi ethu.

Sitshele okungasiza

Sizothanda ukuzwa ukuthi yini esebenza kuwe nokuthi yini engasebenzi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abaphila nedementia, kubanakekeli bemindeni nakubasebenzi bemisebenzi. Thumela i-imeyili ku-{email}.

editorial.title: Indlela Esibhala Ngayo Futhi Esihlola Ngayo Amakhasi Ethu
editorial.description: Ukuthi i-Creative Activities iwucwaninga kanjani, ikubhala kanjani, ithola kanjani imithombo futhi ivuselela kanjani amakhasi ethu emisebenzi nezempilo, nokuthi asizukuke sikushicilele yini.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.title: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo
faq.description: Izimpendulo zemibuzo evamile ngemidlalo nemisebenzi: yiluphi ongalungasa, ungadlala isikhathi esingakanani, amaqembu nemibono yesigaba sokugcina, impilo nemfihlo.
faq.lede: Izimpendulo ezimfishane nezicacile emibuzweni abanakekeli abayibuza kakhulu.

items.a: Imidlalo engcono ijwayelekile, ilula futhi ayinacindezelo, futhi eyilungileyo iwukuthi umuntu uyithanda namuhla. Ukuhlanganisa izithombe ezibonakalayo, ukuhlela, ama-jigsaw alula, ukuqeda izaga ezijwayelekile, ukudweba nokudlala i-bingo yezithombe kusebenza kahle kubantu abaningi. Gwema izikhathi, amaphuzu nanoma yini ezwakala njengevivinyo.
Yebo. Yonke imidlalo lezinto zokuprinta zitholakala mahala, kungeladingeko le-akhawunti, ukubhalisa, ukudawuniloda kumbe izikhangiso.

items.q: Kungani kungelamanqaku, izigaba kumbe iwashi elibalayo?
items.a: Ukuphangisa kanye lamanqaku kuguqula umsebenzi othokozisayo ube njengomhloli, okungadala inhloni kumbe ukukhathazeka. Sibeka umqondo ekuthokozeni lasekuchitheni isikhathi ndawonye, ngakho akukho okokuhluleka njalo lingamisa loba nini.

items.q: Yiziphi izinto zobuchwepheshe ezisebenza kahle kakhulu?
items.a: Loba yiwuphi umakhalekhukhwini, ithebulethi kumbe ikhompuyutha elesiphequluli sewebhu sanamuhla. Ithebulethi esesisekelweni sayo etafuleni ivame ukuba yindlela ekhululekileyo yokuthi abantu ababili badlale behlezi eceleni komunye. Ikhompuyutha ephathekayo exhunywe kuthelevitshini isebenza kahle kakhulu kumaqembu.
Yebo. Umdlalo we-Photo pairs uguqula izithombe ezi-2 kusiya ku-6 ozikhethayo zibe ngumdlalo wokufanisa. Izithombe zisala kusiphequluli sakho njalo azifakwa ku-inthanethi kumbe ukugcinwa.

Kujwayelekile ukuthi imizuzu elitshumi kusiya kwengamatshumi amabili yanele, kanti kwesinye isikhathi imizuzu emibili nje iyingxenye yempumelelo. Qaphelani izimpawu zokudinwa kumbe ukucaphuka, lilise lapho kusathe ntwala ukuthokoza. Akukho sikhathi esibekiweyo esifaneleyo.

Hloniphani ukwala kwabo, lizame njalo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kumbe ngenye indlela. Ukwala kungenzeka kudalwe yikudinwa, ubuhlungu, ukungaqiniseki kumbe ukungabi lentando nje. Bonani isiqondiso sethu esimayelana lalokho okwenziwayo nxa besala.

items.q: Yimiphi imisebenzi efanela isigaba esiphezulu sokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo?
items.a: Ukuthula lezinzwa: ukulalela umculo othandekayo, ukuhlikihla izandla ngamafutha athambileyo, ukubukela izithombe ndawonye, ukugona ingubo ethambileyo, ukuhlala phandle, kumbe umdlalo olula kakhulu wezithombe umuntu ehlezi eceleni kwabo. Isiqondiso sethu sesigaba esiphezulu silamacebo amanengi kakhulu.

items.q: Ikhona yini imisebenzi yamaqembu ezindlini zabanakekelwa?
items.a: Yebo. I-Picture bingo ilamakhadi angaphrintwa kanye lomemezeli osekrini, kanti i-Finish the saying lamakhadi e-Conversation cards asebenza kahle nxa ebalwa ngokuzwakalayo. Isiqondiso sethu samaqembu ezindlini zabanakekelwa sichasisa ngobukhulu beqembu, ukuhlalisana kanye lokulungiselela abantu abalamandla angafananiyo.

items.q: Imidlalo ingavikela kumbe yehlise ukuhamba kokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo?
items.a: Akulamdlalo oke watshengisa ukuthi uyavikela ukulahlekelwa yinkumbulo, njalo lemidlalo yethu ayitsho njalo. Ukuvuselela ingqondo emphakathini kuke kwatshengisa inzuzo encane ocwaningweni lwabantu abaphila lokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo okuncane kusiya phakathi, kodwa lokho kwehlukile ekutheni umdlalo unqande umkhuhlane. Sinikela imidlalo ngenxa yokuthokoza lokwakha ubudlelwano.

Hatshi ngokuqiniseka. Ucwaningo luhlanganisa izinto ezi-14 zempilakahle lendlela yokuphila lengozi yokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo, ezifana lokungezwa ezindlebeni, umfutho ophezulu wegazi, ukungawuvocavoci umzimba kanye lokuhlala wedwa ungekho labanye. Ukuzilungisa kungenzeka kwehlise ingozi kwabanye abantu, kodwa abantu abanengi abenza konke okulungileyo balokhu behlaselwa yikulahlekelwa yinkumbulo. Akusiso iphutha lomuntu loba nini.

items.q: Ukuzila ukudla ngezikhathi ezithile kulungele impilakahle yengqondo yini?
items.a: Ubufakazi obusebantwini bucuthekile njalo kusesekuqaleni, kanti ucwaningo olunengi lwenziwe ezinyameni. Ukuzila ukudla kungaba lengozi kwabadala, ikakhulu nxa kuthathwa imithi yesifo seshukela kumbe ukuhla komzimba okungaqondwanga, njalo akukhuthazwa kubantu abaphila lokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo. Khulumani lodokotela lingakaguquli indlela elidla ngayo.

Akulamakhawunti kumbe izikhangiso. Sisebenzisa i-Google Analytics ukubala abavakatsheli lokubona ukuthi ngamaphi amakhasi ancedayo, kanti isiphequluli sakho siyakhumbula ukuthi uvulile yini imisindo ethambileyo. Izithombe ozikhethela i-Photo pairs azilokothi zifakwe ku-inthanethi. Bonani isaziso semfihlo ukuze lithole imininingwane.
Hatshi. I-Creative Activities ngeyokuzilibazisa kanye lemininingwane ejwayelekileyo. Emibuzweni yezempilakahle, khulumani lodokotela, kanti nxa kulesimo esiphuthumayo fonelani u-999.

faq.moreHtml: Ulwazi oluningiliziwe: indlela yokudlala ndawonye, lapho bethi cha, imisebenzi yesigaba sokugcina kanye nemisebenzi ye-dementia ekhaya.

handout.title: Imidlalo Yamahala, Ethambileyo Yabantu Abaphila Lokulahlekelwa Yinkumbulo
handout.seoTitle: Iphepha Eliprintwayo: Imidlalo Yamahala Yokulahlekelwa Yinkumbulo Ku-inthanethi
handout.description: Iphepha elilodwa eliprintwayo lemuli labanakekeli elimayelana lemidlalo yezithombe yamahala lethambileyo yabantu abaphila lokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo, elenzelwe amaqembu osekelo lezikhwama zosizo.
handout.lede: Printani leli khasi ngenxa yeqembu losekelo, iphakethe lokunakekela kumbe esivalweni sefriji. Sebenzisani umyalo wokugcinda wesiphequluli senu; amamenyu lamabhathini akukhutshwa ekhasini eliprintwayo.
handout.introHtml: Izithombe ezinkulu, amagama alula njalo akukho okokuhluleka. Mahala efonini, ethebulethini kumbe kukhompuyutha, kungelakubhalisa, kungelazikhangiso, kungelamawashi abalayo njalo kungelamanqaku. Hlalani eceleni komunye liyekelane amathuba.
handout.restHtml:
Amacebiso ambalwa

  • Khethani isikhathi sosuku lapho umuntu azizwa ehloniphekile kumbe enamile kakhulu khona.
  • Qalisani ngesilungiselelo esilula kakhulu. Izikwele ezine zanele kakhulu.
  • Xoxani ngezithombe. Ingxoxo iyona evame ukuba yingxenye enhle kakhulu.
  • Phelisani lapho kusathokozisa. Ukuphetha masinya kungumphumela omuhle.

Okunye okukuwebhusayithi

  • Izinto zokuprinta zamahala: ukucinga amagama ngamabala amakhulu, amakhasi okufaka imibala, amakhadi engxoxo kanye le-picture bingo.
  • Amacebo emisebenzi yezigaba zonke, kanye leziqondiso zokudlala ndawonye kanye lokuzinakekela.

Okwokuthokoza kanye lokuchitha isikhathi ndawonye. Akusiso iseluleko sezokwelapha, ukuhlolwa kumbe ukwelatshwa. I-Creative Activities ishicilelwe yi-Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.title: Okwamakhaya Abanakekelwa, Izindlu Zamabhuku Lamaqembu Osekelo
organizations.seoTitle: Imisebenzi Yamahhala Yezindawo Zokunakekela, Amalabhulali Namaqembu
organizations.description: Indlela izindawo zokunakekela, izinhlelo zabantu abadala zansuku zonke, amalabhulali, izinhlangano zokuguga namaqembu okwesekwa osebenzisa ngayo imidlalo yethu yamahhala nezincwadi zemisebenzi, kanye nombhalo wokusifaka ohlwini lwezinsiza.
organizations.lede: Konke okukulikheli lewebhusayithi kumahhala ukukusebenzisa labahlali, amalunga labantu elibasebenzelayo, kungela akhawunti, ilayisensi kumbe imali ebhadelwayo. Likhasi lichaza okutholakala lapha lendlela yokukwabelana labanye.
organizations.shortText: {name}: imidlalo yezithombe emnene namahhala nezincwadi zemisebenzi zabantu abadala, imindeni nabantu abaphila nedementia. Akukho ukubhalisa, akukho iwashi, akukho maphuzu.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) inikeza imidlalo engu-{count} emahhala yebhulawuzi yabadala, yemindeni kanye nabantu abaphila ngesifo sokukhohlwa, kuhlanganise nemidlalo yokuhlanganisa izithombe ezisalokhu zibonakala, ukuhlanganisa okulula, ukuhlunga, izinsumo ezijwayelekile kanye nebingo yezithombe enamakhadi angaphrintwa. Asikho i-akhawunti, isikhangiso, isikhathi noma amaphuzu. Le ndawo iphinde ibe nemihlahlandlela yemisebenzi elula yemindeni, yabadala kanye nabasebenzi, enemithombo efana ne-National Institute on Aging kanye ne-Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: Imidlalo engu-{count} yebhrawuza esebenza kukhompuyutha ephathwayo, ithebhulethe kumbe kumabonakude oxhunywe kukhompuyutha. Akudingi ukuyifaka ohlelweni, akhawunti kumbe ukuyidawuniloda. Bona yonke imidlalo.
organizations.printablesAfter: Sebenzisa inkinobho ethi Print ekhasini ngalinye.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Izinhlobo zamaqembu: Picture bingo inamakhadi angaphrintwa kanye nombizi osesikrinini, kanti imidlalo yengxoxo inemibuzo enezinketho zokuphendula kanye namaphuzu okuxoxa ngawo.
  • Imihlahlandlela yemisebenzi yabasebenzi nemindeni, ebhalwe ngolimi olulula kanye nemithombo. Qala nge-101 imibono yemisebenzi noma nge-imisebenzi yamaqembu ezindawo zokunakekelwa kwabadala.
organizations.restHtml:
Indlela amaqembu akusebenzisa ngayo

  • Izindlu zabagugileyo lezindawo zokunakekela inkumbulo: i-bingo yemifanekiso kumbe ukuqedelela izaga kumabonakude wekamelo lokuhlala, lapho umuntu oyedwa eqofa esikrinini emela iqembu.
  • Izinhlelo zabadala zasemini: indawo yethebhulethe ele-Picture pairs ehlelwe yamathayela amane, eyenzelwe izikhathi ezimfushane zomuntu lomuntu.
  • Izindlu zamabhuku zomphakathi: ukudinga amagama okuprintiweyo lamakhadi okuxoxa ezikhwameni zenkumbulo, kanye lewebhusayithi efakwe kumabhukhmakhi kumathebhulethe endlu yamabhuku.
  • Amaqembu okusekelana kwabanakekeli lama-memory café: ipheshana elilodwa eliprintwayo elenzelwe izimuli ukuthi zihambe lalo ekhaya.
  • Izibhedlela labahlela ukugoduka kwabantu: ipheshana elisezikhwameni zabanakekeli, elenzelwe okuthile okuzolileyo okungenziwa ekhaya kumbe eceleni kombhede.

Esingakwenziyo

Imidlalo le yenzelwe ukuthokozisa lokuchitha isikhathi ndawonye. Ayihloli ukugula, ayivivinye, ayiniki amaphuzu, ayelaphi kumbe ukunciphisa ukuhamba phambili kokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo, njalo sicela izinhlanganiso ukuthi zingayichazi ngaleyondlela. Akulazikhangiso, kanti lemidlalo ayiceli amabizo, imininingwane yezempilakahle kumbe ukuthi kukhwezwe imifanekiso. Iwebhusayithi isebenzisa i-Google Analytics ukubala abavakatshela kuyo; isaziso sethu sobumfihlo sichaza lokho ekubuthayo. Imifanekiso esetshenziswa ku-Photo pairs isala kubhrawuza kuphela.

Sifake ohlwini lwakho lwezinsiza

Uba ulelohlu lwezinsiza zabanakekeli, wamukelekile ukufaka isixhumanisi esiya ku-{domain}. Ungakopela incazelo ngayinye kwezimbili lezi.
organizations.linksHtml:
Amakhasi asizayo okungawaxhumanisa ngqo: imidlalo emahhala, amaphrinta amahhala, imisebenzi yesifo sokukhohlwa ekhaya kanye indlela yokudlala ndawonye.

Imibuzo noma izilungiso

Uma kukhona okungalungile noma okungacacile kule ndawo, noma izidingo zomuntu ohlala endaweni yokunakekelwa zingafezeki yilokho okukhona apha, sicela usitshele ku-{email}. Sicela ungathumeli ulwazi lomuntu siqu noma lwezempilo lwabahlali noma lwamakhasimende.

app.title: I-App ye-Creative Activities
app.description: I-app yamahala ye-Creative Activities: ukufanisa imifanekiso okuthambileyo ngamathayela amane amakhulu, imifanekiso yemuli egcinwa kudivayisi yakho, izinqwaba zemifanekiso ezisebenza ingekho i-inthanethi njalo kungela akhawunti.
app.lede: Konke okuthandayo ngewebhusayithi, phakathi kwe-app esebenza ingekho i-inthanethi njalo engasebenzisa imifanekiso yemuli oyikhethayo.
app.bodyHtml:
Qalani ngokuncane

Qalani ngamakhasi amane amakhulu lemifanekiso eyaziwayo. Yekelani imifanekiso ibonakale, loba liyifihle nxa libona kufanele. Indlela elula kayilaso isikhathi esibalwayo, amamaki loba inhlawulo. Khethani amakhasi angu-4, 6, 8 loba 12.

Kwenzeni okwasekhaya

Khethani izithombe zemuli lisebenzisa isikhethi sezithombe sedivayisi yenu. Uhlelo lolu lubeka amakhophi amancane emisebenzi yalo. Kaluhlolisisi yonke imifanekiso yenu loba luntshintshe izithombe zenu zakuqala, njalo lugcina izithombe ezingafika ku-24 eqoqweni linye.

Khangelani ndawonye nje

Bukani umfanekiso owodwa ngesikhathi. Imibuzo ongayikhetha iqalisa ingxoxo ngaphandle kokubophezela umuntu ukuthi akhumbule amabizo loba aphendule ngokuqondileyo. Ukubuka nje kwanele.

Kusebenza lanxa kungekho intanethi

Imifanekiso yokuqala kanye lezixha zonke eziyisificaminwembili zifakwe phakathi kohlelo lolu. Amakhophi ezithombe afakiweyo ayasebenza ngaphandle kwentanethi. Ukukhetha izithombe zakuqala ezigcinwe ku-iCloud kuphela kungadinga intanethi.

Akula-akhawunti, akulamaseva okuvumelanisa izithombe

Amakhophi ezithombe zemuli asala phakathi kohlelo kudivayisi yenu. Lingasusa amakhophi la ngaphandle kokucima izithombe zenu zakuqala. Ukubekela eceleni kwedivayisi kungafaka phakathi imininingwane yalolu hlelo. Balani inqubo yobumfihlo yohlelo, njalo usizo lohlelo luchasisa igxathu ngalinye.
app.disclaimer: I-Creative Activities yenzelwe ukuzithokozisa lengxoxo zokwabelana. Kayihloli, kayelaphi, kayivimbi njalo kayilinganisi umkhuhlane wokukhohlwa loba i-Alzheimer.

gamesIndex.byStageLede: Izigaba ziyisiqondiso nje. Landelani lokho okuthokozisa umuntu omnakekelayo lalokho okumnandi kuye lamuhla.
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Imibono yemisebenzi engesikrini: 101 imibono yemisebenzi, imisebenzi yesifo sokukhohlwa ekhaya kanye ukwenza izinto ngezandla.

faq.a: Ukutshayanisa imifanekiso ngamakhasi amane yikhetho lokuqala elithuleyo. Nxa ukukhetha phakathi kwemifanekiso kubonakala kunzima, lingazama okokuthi Thola okufanayo ngemifanekiso emibili. Eqoqweni labantu, zamani i-Picture bingo.

faq.q: Imidlalo le iyasebenza ku-iPad loba efonini?
faq.a: Yebo. Umdlalo ngamunye usebenza kusiphequluli kumafoni, kumathebulethi lakukhompyutha, njalo imifanekiso iyakhula ukugcwalisa isikrini. Ithebulethi ebekwe esisekelweni ivamise ukunethezisa kakhulu abantu ababili.

faq.q: Imidlalo le ilungele umuntu ophila le-Alzheimer na?
faq.a: Yebo. Yenzelwe abantu abaphila lomkhuhlane wokukhohlwa, okugoqela i-Alzheimer, okuyiyo ebangela kakhulu. Imifanekiso ihlala ibonakala, kulezinketho ezimbalwa kuphela, njalo akulamuntu obalelwa isikhathi loba amamaki, ngakho imidlalo le igxila ekuboneni izinto ezijwayelekileyo kulokukhumbula izinto ezintsha.

faq.q: Le yimidlalo yokukhumbula eyenzelwe abantu abadala na?
faq.a: Ziyimidlalo yokuhlanganisa nezithombe engayijabulela noma yimuphi umdala, kodwa yakhelwe ukungayihloli inkumbulo: ku-Picture pairs izithombe ziyahlala zivulekile ngaphandle uma ukhetha ngenye indlela. Noma yimuphi umdlalo wenkumbulo ungenziwa ube lula ngokususa isikhathi namaphuzu.

faq.q: Ikhona yini imidlalo yamaqembu asemakhaya okunakekela?
faq.a: Yebo. I-Picture bingo ilamakhadi angaphrintwa lommemezeli osesikrinini, njalo i-Finish the saying le-Conversation cards zisebenza kuhle nxa zibalelwa phezulu eqenjini.

print.pointTarget: Ephepheni, isithombe okufanele usibheke sisebhokisini ekuqaleni komugqa ngamunye. Khomba isithombe esikhundleni sokusithinta, noma usibungaze ngepeni.
print.halves: Isithombe ngasinye sinqunywe phakathi. Dweba umugqa usuka engxenyeni ngayinye ngakwesokhohlo uye engxenyeni efanele ngakwesokudla, noma khomba ngomunwe. Akudingeki ukunqunywa lutho.
print.grid: Isikwele ngasinye sinenombolo. Thola leyo nombolo ku-khiye, bese ukhanyisa isikwele ngopensile walowo mbala. Noma yimuphi omunye umbala owuthandayo nawo uyavumelekile. Akudingeki ukunqunywa lutho.
print.colors: Umugqa ngamunye ubiza umbala. Khomba zonke izithombe ezinalowo mbala, noma usibungaze ngepeni. Umugqa ngamunye useyisethi entsha.
print.dice: Umugqa ngamunye useyisethi yamadayisi. Khetha umugqa, noma nquma izithombe uzidonse esitokweni, bese ulandisa indaba usebenzisa zona noma ngayiphi indlela. Noma ubani angadlula.
print.words: Nquma amagama, noma dweba umugqa usuka kwigama ngalinye uye esithombeni salo. Funda amagama ngokuzwakalayo njengoba uqhubeka.
print.cards: Nquma amakhadi emigqeni eshiywe ngamachashazi. Abeke ngobuso phezulu etafuleni, bese uthola amapheya.
print.chain: Ephepheni, funda izithombe usuka kwesokhohlo uye kwesokudla, ngokulandelana. Umuntu ngamunye ushong'a isivakalisi esisodwa ngezithombe ezikhona kuze kube manje, bese ekhomba isithombe esilandelayo. Noma ubani angadlula.
print.sort: Nquma izithombe emgqeni oshiywe ngamachashazi, bese ubeka ngayinye ebhokisini okufanele ibe kuwo.
print.puzzle: Nquma isithombe esikhulu emgqeni oshiywe ngamachashazi sibe yizicucu ezine, bese uxuba. Shintshanisa izicucu ezimbili ngesikhathi size isithombe siphelele. Isithombe esincane siyisiqondisi.
print.cutSafety: Umsizi angakunquma ngaphambi kokuqala. Emva kwalokho faka izikelo endaweni yazo.

reasons.photos: Akukho inguqulo yephepha. Lo mdlalo usebenzisa izithombe zakho, ezihlala zisebhulawuzini lakho azikaze zilayishwe, ngakho ikhasi alikwazi ukuzi-phrinta. Ukuze udlale ephepheni, phrinta amakhophi amabili ezithombe ezimbalwa ozithandayo ekhaya bese uzihlanganisa etafuleni.
reasons.paced: Akukho inguqulo yephepha. Isangqa sibeka isivinini esihamba kancane esikrinini, kanti ikhasi eliphrintiwe alikwazi ukwenza lokho, ngakho kungaba yisenzo esihlukile. Ukuphumula okuthulile ndawonye ngaphandle kwesikrini kusoke kube ikhetho njalo.
reasons.turns: Akukho inguqulo yephepha yalo mdlalo. Ukuze uthole amapheya etafuleni, phrinta amakhadi ezithombe ku-Picture pairs bese niyashintshana ukuwaphendulela.
reasons.screen: Es ayikho inguqulo yephepha. Lesi yisithombe okubukwa ngaso ndawonye esikrinini; isithombe esithandwayo noma ikhadi lepositi etafuleni lenza into efanayo.
reasons.wash: Ayikho inguqulo yephepha. Ukupenda ngamanzi ephepheni kunombono ofanayo: ibhulashi elimanzi kanye nombala owodwa ngesikhathi.
reasons.sayings: Ayikho inguqulo yephepha okwamanje. Ephepheni zonke iziphetho zonke bezizobonakala ngesikhathi esisodwa, futhi isinyathelo esibucayi esithi "Bonisa isiphetho" besizolahleka. Funda izinkulumo esikrinini ndawonye, noma yabelana ngezimbalwa eniyaziyo nobabili.
